reviews.name: Despina M.
reviews.project: Premium brand website design in Figma
reviews.quote:
It was a pleasure working with Abdulkaiz on my website design. He took the time to understand the direction I was trying to achieve and translated it into a polished, professional Figma design that feels very aligned with the brand.

He was extremely patient and responsive throughout the process, particularly as we worked through the finer details and refinements. He was always happy to make adjustments, communicated clearly, and made the whole process easy to work through.

I also really appreciated the care he took with the final developer handoff, including documenting the functionality and interactions to help make the transition into WordPress development as smooth as possible.

I’m very happy with the final result and would absolutely recommend Abdulkaiz to anyone looking for a thoughtful, reliable and talented UI/website designer. Thank you again for all your work!
